ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast; approximately 80% high-intensity white background vs 20% low-intensity black pigmentation clusters across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white field with dense, localized black circular spots (mottling) distributed primarily in the distal regions; solid black pigmentation is concentrated at the fluke-to-peduncle junction and follows the median notch boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 5-15 pixels, creating a jagged linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the leading edge tapering to sharp, pointed distal tips; the trailing edge follows a generally concave path toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible clusters of light-colored, textured calcified growths (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the left lobe, extending from the mid-section toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization at the distal tips; parallel linear rake marks on the left ventral lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric distribution of black focal spots, with higher density on the right lobe compared to the left mid-section.
